name: Behind The Back Lateral Raise (Cable)
instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley, holding the handle behind your back.
Raise your arm out to the side until it's parallel to the floor.
The behind-body position keeps tension on the delt through the full range.
Lower slowly and repeat. A cable lateral raise with a longer stretch.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Behind The Back Lateral Raise (Cable) is an intermediate pushing exercise for the middle delts, performed with a cable machine. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
